blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: data mining — Extracting patterns from datasets.
correlation — Statistical association, not proof of cause.
outlier — Observation unusually far from others.

blocks.title: Identify the question
blocks.text: Data mining searches for useful patterns in a set of records; decide what question the analysis should answer.

blocks.title: Choose a suitable chart
blocks.text: Scatter charts show relationships between two numeric variables; bars compare categories; histograms show numeric distributions.

blocks.title: Interpret responsibly
blocks.text: An association does not prove that one variable causes another. Consider sample size, bias, missing data and outliers.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: As x increases, y increases in this small sample, indicating positive association.

blocks.text: No causal claim is justified without additional evidence or experimental design.
